intros n
have h : (2 * n + 1).gcd (n + 1) = (n + 1).gcd (2 * n + 1) := Nat.gcd_comm
have h2 : (n + 1).gcd (2 * n + 1) = (n + 1).gcd (2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1)) := Nat.gcd_sub_left_mul
simp [h2] at h
have h3 : 2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1) = -1 := by simp
rw [h3] at h
have h4 : (n + 1).gcd (-1) = 1 := Int.gcd_negSucc_ofNat (n + 1) 1
rw [h4] at h
exact h
